The bug has been fixed in accordance with the requirements specified in [`summary.txt`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_1_group_b_fix/summary.txt).

### Summary of Changes:
- Modified [`NumberUtils.createNumber(final String str)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_1_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/math/NumberUtils.java#L464-L480) in [`NumberUtils.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_1_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/math/NumberUtils.java) to:
  1. Strip leading zeros following the hexadecimal prefix to determine significant digits and the first significant digit character.
  2. Select `BigInteger` when significant hex digits exceed 16, or when 16 digits and the first digit exceeds `'7'` (i.e. > `Long.MAX_VALUE`).
  3. Select `Long` when significant hex digits exceed 8, or when 8 digits and the first digit exceeds `'7'` (i.e. > `Integer.MAX_VALUE`).
  4. Otherwise select `Integer`.

### Verification:
- The failing test `org.apache.commons.lang3.math.NumberUtilsTest::TestLang747` and the full `NumberUtilsTest` suite pass.
- Saved the focused patch to [`nl_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_1_group_b_fix/nl_fix.patch).
